text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon! She has finally achieved the 
Triple Tiara――!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I did it...! I gave it my all, I really 
pulled it off!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazoooon! You were amazing! That 
was the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"The undisputed queen of the Tiara route 
is Hishi Amazon!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Alllriiiight!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The thunderous applause echoing through 
the stands showed no sign of stopping for 
quite a while.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
That was a fantastic race! Congratulations 
on winning the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks! Having such an awesome 
one-on-one showdown has left me totally 
satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, but still... I definitely 
couldn't have made it here on my own.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Making a thick training booklet for me, 
climbing mountains together with me—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: My passionate, unbeatable partner, <username>.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I made it this far because I had you. Now 
I can face her with my head held high.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if calming the cameras that had all 
turned toward her at once, Hishi Amazon 
continued speaking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Still, it ain't over yet. If anything, 
our one-on-one starts right now.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Meaning what, exactly?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's someone in the Twinkle Series I 
absolutely have to take on one-on-one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the mention of the monstrous Umamusume 
taking the world by storm, the press 
conference hall buzzes with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...But before the Classic year, I just 
wasn't cut out to challenge her."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided to tear through the 
Tiara path and be reborn as an even 
stronger version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And now! By winning the Triple Tiara, I've 
become the "Hishi Amazon" I can truly be 
proud of!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So from here on out— I'm throwing down the 
gauntlet to Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Which means the next race is—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the Arima Kinen... where they'll be 
waiting!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
So Narita Brian and Hishi Amazon are 
finally going to clash on the grandest 
stage...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"If Narita Brian wins the Triple Crown 
too... that's going to be one incredible 
race!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! If you don't mind, could you 
say a few words to Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon directed a combative glare at 
the camera.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian. I've been chasing after you this 
whole time. The Arima Kinen is the 
showdown I've been waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—I'm Hishi Amazon! I'm coming at you with 
everything I've got, so just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"And that's that, Tre-dude! Let's tackle 
this with everything we've got!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon's grand declaration of war 
was widely reported across various media.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. The 'Arima Kinen', huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days of pushing ourselves 
to the limit in preparation for the 
upcoming one-on-one showdown against 
Narita Brian.
